title: ask Stage 2 placement watcher CDP WS race silent-yield
desc: Stage 2 placement watcher TryStage2PageLoadWait suppresses BUG-AUTO suggest on benign CDP WS races (ws_receive_error/ws_closed/no_ws_url/timeout/ws_open_failed/cdp_enable_failed). Companion of a11y-focus-steal-user-active-silent-yield. Affects ask gpt/gemini/claude/triad -- stops Stage 2 suggest storm.
steps: Stage 2 placement watcher opens secondary CDP WS for Page.loadEventFired after Stage 1 placement
Secondary WS races against foreground ASK CDP traffic -- transient ws frame errors are benign
Silent-yield gate (2026-05-16): BUG-AUTO fires ONLY when placementOk=false AND trigger is cdp_error_frame or error:Exception
All benign race triggers logged as [PLACEMENT:STAGE2] suppress BUG-AUTO (silent-yield)
Affected commands: ask gpt, ask gemini, ask claude, ask triad

2026-05-16 FIXED: CancellationTokenSource timeout changed 3000ms->10000ms in MyCdpContext.Stage23.cs. Added explicit catch(OperationCanceledException) returning 'timeout' instead of swallowing as ws_receive_error. Commit 87d75eb0. Stage23.cs subsequently split into Stage23(327L)+Stage3(148L)+Stage23Ws(161L) partial classes to meet 400-line cap, commit a317dc4b.
